ai.text: This bill would require the Department of Justice to set up a task force, program, or similar structure within its Criminal Division. Its job would be to investigate and prosecute crimes related to international trade.

summary.label: Congressional Research Service, Introduced in House
summary.text:
Protecting American Industry and Labor from International Trade Crimes Act of 2025
This bill requires the Department of Justice to establish a task force, program, or other similar structure within its Criminal Division to investigate and prosecute trade-related crimes.
